id.description: Globally unique identifier for this observation.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "Observation" for Observation entities.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this observation record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this observation record was last updated.

locations.description: Location identifiers or names where the observation occurred.

timeOfObservation.description: Date and time when the observation occurred.

observer.description: Member who made the report about what they observed.
